none: PAS WILT-F0A3A1: Silver medieval annular brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Description: A Medieval silver annular brooch. The brooch is circular in plan and rectangular in cross section, both the front face and reverse face are flat. The frame has a constriction for the pin, which is 22.15mm long. The pin has been folded over the frame and tapers towards the tip.
